newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon navy rescues 75 stranded Syrians.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon navy rescues 75 stranded Syrians.

text.p: The Lebanese navy on Tuesday rescued 75 Syrians who had been stranded without food for three days on a small island off northern Lebanon, the Lebanese army said.
Earlier, security sources identified those rescued as Iraqi Kurds.

In a statement published by Lebanon's official National News Agency, the army said the Syrians who included women and children, were promised to be taken to Greece by "elements who work in smuggling people to the Ramkeen island, before they leave to Greece".
Ramkeen is a small nature reserve three km (two miles) off the northern port of Tripoli.
"Three were admitted to hospital and all others were detained," the statement said.
The army said it also detained two men suspected of involvement in smuggling people between Lebanon and Syria.
